description: This file is a PHP script that manages user authentication, locale setting, and session handling for a web-based UI. It includes logic for setting locale, handling login attempts for 'mso' and 'admin' users, token verification, and routing based on login status and inputs. It also contains utility functions for IP and session management.

methods.name: innerIP
methods.description: Checks if the client's IP is within the internal network by examining server environment and network interfaces.

methods.name: get_ips
methods.description: Retrieves list of IP addresses assigned to a given network interface.

methods.name: if_type
methods.description: Determines the type of IP address: LAN, CM, or RG based on network configuration.

methods.name: create_session
methods.description: Initializes a session with locale settings, session ID, and login user info.

methods.name: getAuthenticationUrl
methods.description: Constructs an authentication URL for OAuth based on endpoint and redirect URI.
